# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Before planning code changes, read [GOAL.md](../GOAL.md), [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), and relevant findings in [docs/COGNITIVE_RESEARCH_JOURNAL.md](../docs/COGNITIVE_RESEARCH_JOURNAL.md).

This is the Scenario-Chunking **research** repository, not production Sonara. GOAL.md sets the north-star objective, not a claim of completed features. Use existing cognitive owners and trace the live signal path. Prove learning and decision consequences on withheld, controlled tests; preserve negative results and historical baselines. Keep runtime thin and avoid parallel cognition, unapproved live external actions and unsafe self-modification. Follow AGENTS.md for planning, verification and scoped Git changes.
